patterns.note: The hero section uses dynamically overlapping and angled historical images, creating a collage-like effect that breaks the traditional grid.
A vibrant, almost neon, secondary color palette is used as translucent overlays on historical monochromatic imagery, creating a striking contrast and modern feel.

As the user scrolls down, the large overlapping hero images parallax independently, sliding upwards and outwards to reveal the main content sections below. A sticky navigation bar appears at the top of the viewport.
The 'Explore' section features a dense grid of square image cards, each with a distinct vibrant color overlay and a short title, creating a visually engaging and organized content index.
Headings use a classic serif typeface, providing an editorial and historical feel, contrasted with a clean sans-serif for body text and navigation elements.

technique_notes: The hero section's overlapping images are achieved by positioning elements absolutely with varying z-indices and applying CSS transforms for rotation and skew, creating an angled, dynamic composition. These elements then animate their position and scale on scroll to create a parallax effect.
Sections are revealed using a scroll-triggered animation that slides them up into view from the bottom of the viewport with a subtle fade-in effect as they enter the visible area.

The vibrant color overlays on images are created using semi-transparent color layers positioned over the monochromatic historical photographs, allowing the underlying image texture to show through while adding a modern color accent.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, editorial serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, clean sans-serif body text and uppercase navigation labels.
design_tokens.spacing: airy in hero and between main sections, with a denser grid layout for content cards within sections.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its bold and playful use of vibrant, semi-transparent color overlays on historical, monochromatic imagery, creating a unique visual tension. The dynamic, angled overlapping elements in the hero and the structured yet colorful 'Explore' grid give it a fresh, editorial, and almost art-gallery feel that stands apart from typical informational sites.
